title: Pan-Seared Norwegian Salmon with Nimble Tacos
description: A delicious and healthy dish that combines the flavors of Norway with the simplicity of tacos. Pan-seared Norwegian salmon is served with a nimble twist, adding a unique flavor to this classic dish.
instructions: Preheat a non-stick skillet over medium-high heat.
Season the Norwegian salmon fillets with salt and pepper.
Add a small amount of oil to the skillet and sear the salmon for 3-4 minutes on each side.
Remove the salmon from the skillet and set aside.
Warm the nimble tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Spoon a small amount of taco seasoning onto each tortilla, followed by a piece of pan-seared salmon.
Top with sliced avocado, chopped cilantro, and a squeeze of lime juice.
